name: SplineFollower
src_typeComment: Runtime companion to SplinePath: moves a transform along it at a constant WORLD-SPACE speed (via arc- length reparameterization, not raw t — otherwise speed would vary with how the control points happen to be spaced). Deliberately separate from the editor-time PathBuilder: moving something along a spline at play time is a different job from authoring the spline's shape, and this works with ANY SplinePath, including one that was never fed into a PathBuilder at all (a patrol path, a camera rail, ...).

src_serialized.name: target
src_serialized.tooltip: What moves along the path. Defaults to this object's own Transform if left empty.

src_serialized.name: orientToTangent
src_serialized.tooltip: Rotates the target to face its direction of travel along the curve.

src_serialized.name: rotationSharpness
src_serialized.tooltip: Higher = snappier turning to face the tangent, lower = more lag. Frame-rate-independent exponential smoothing, not a raw Lerp/Slerp factor.

src_serialized.name: startDistance
src_serialized.tooltip: Starting distance along the path, in world units.

src_members.name: Tick
src_members.comment: The actual movement logic, pulled out of Update() so it can be driven deterministically by a self- test — Time.deltaTime is meaningless outside Play mode, so a test calls this directly with a fixed step instead of relying on Update ever running.
